summary: Requirements for a one-command build.sh source launcher that prepares and opens the existing AppForge-LLM v4 local web app UI.

in_scope: Repository-root build.sh launcher for source checkout users.
Python environment preparation using existing project metadata.
Frontend dependency/build preparation for packaged FastAPI static assets.
Delegation to the existing appforge web loopback server with automatic browser opening by default.
No-browser smoke mode for deterministic verification.
Optional llm_bridge process startup only when requested by driver/configuration.
README, web guide, and changelog documentation.
out_of_scope: Changing AppForge pipeline semantics, job APIs, or Vue UI layout.
Adding deployment, native desktop packaging, Docker, launch agents, or production process supervision.
Removing or deprecating the existing appforge CLI entry points.

functional_requirements.statement: A repository-root build.sh must launch the existing local web app UI as the default source-start path.
acceptance_criteria: build.sh exists at repository root and is executable.
Normal mode delegates to .venv/bin/appforge web or an equivalent local appforge module entry point.
Default host is 127.0.0.1 and default port is 8787 unless overridden by environment variables.
Normal mode leaves browser opening enabled through the existing appforge web behavior.

functional_requirements.statement: The launcher must prepare source dependencies enough for the packaged web app to run.
acceptance_criteria: If installation is not skipped, the launcher uses uv sync --extra dev when uv is available.
If uv is unavailable, the launcher creates .venv with python3 and installs -e '.[dev]' through pip.
If frontend installation/build is not skipped, the launcher installs frontend dependencies when node_modules is missing and runs npm --prefix frontend run build.
Clear error messages are emitted for missing python3, npm, or required commands.

functional_requirements.statement: The launcher must support fast, repeatable, non-interactive verification without opening a browser.
acceptance_criteria: --smoke starts the web server with browser opening disabled.
--smoke polls /api/health and / until both return HTTP 200 or a bounded timeout expires.
--smoke terminates the server it started before exiting.
APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 and APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 allow smoke checks to reuse already-prepared local dependencies.

functional_requirements.statement: The launcher must respect existing runtime configuration and make llm_bridge startup optional.
acceptance_criteria: APPFORGE_DRIVER and other existing AppForge environment variables pass through to appforge web.
The launcher does not force APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge.
When APPFORGE_DRIVER is llm-bridge or APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE=1 is set, the launcher starts llm_bridge only if Bun is available and no bridge health endpoint is already reachable.
Bridge startup is skipped when APPFORGE_SKIP_LLM_BRIDGE=1 is set.

functional_requirements.statement: Documentation must present build.sh as the easiest source UI path while preserving CLI compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: README.md fastest-start source instructions show ./build.sh before manual setup commands.
docs/WEB_APP.md start instructions mention ./build.sh and the smoke/no-open options.
CHANGELOG.md records the launcher and smoke verification behavior.
Docs state that existing appforge web and frontend dev commands remain available.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The launcher must remain local-first and safe by default.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Default host remains 127.0.0.1; no deployment, public bind, destructive operation, or credential collection is added.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The launcher must be deterministic enough for CI-style local smoke checks.
non_functional_requirements.measure: bash -n build.sh and APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke both pass in the prepared workspace.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The change must preserve existing backend and frontend behavior.
non_functional_requirements.measure: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q, npm --prefix frontend run typecheck, and npm --prefix frontend run build pass after implementation.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Repeat runs should not force slow dependency work when the workspace is already prepared.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Environment flags allow install and frontend build steps to be skipped, and frontend install only runs automatically when node_modules is absent.

user_flows: A source user runs ./build.sh, waits for dependency/build preparation, and the default browser opens http://127.0.0.1:8787 with the existing AppForge web UI.
A developer runs APPFORGE_SKIP_INSTALL=1 APPFORGE_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./build.sh --smoke to verify the packaged UI and health endpoint without browser interaction.
A provider-backed user runs APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge ./build.sh and, when Bun is available, the launcher starts or reuses the local bridge before opening the UI.
assumptions: Prepared workspaces may use skip flags for faster verification; first-run source setup may require local package-manager access.
The existing web app remains the authoritative UX; the launcher is only an ergonomic entry point.
Bridge provider credentials and active model configuration remain managed by existing environment variables and web provider settings.

risks.risk: A smoke run could leave a server running on the configured port.
risks.impact: Subsequent runs fail due to port contention.
risks.mitigation: Track the started server PID and kill it in an EXIT trap.

risks.risk: Dependency installation could fail in a network-restricted environment.
risks.impact: First-run launcher cannot prepare from scratch.
risks.mitigation: Support skip flags for already-prepared workspaces and keep verification explicit about local dependency state.

risks.risk: Forcing bridge startup could block non-bridge users.
risks.impact: The default web UI path becomes harder than the CLI.
risks.mitigation: Start bridge only when llm-bridge driver or explicit APPFORGE_START_LLM_BRIDGE is selected.

quality_gates.evidence: Launcher starts web server, probes /api/health and /, and exits cleanly.

quality_gates.gate: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
quality_gates.evidence: Frontend TypeScript contract and packaged assets remain valid.

traceability.relationship: Launcher existence and web server start
